# aiwebscan.nl

> AI Agent Readiness, GEO and technical discovery diagnostics for websites.

aiwebscan.nl scans public website responses for crawlability, technical SEO, AI-content discovery, bot access, structured data, security and agent/API readiness.

## Scanner
- [AI Agent Readiness Scanner](https://aiwebscan.nl/): run a public audit.
- [How the scan works](https://aiwebscan.nl/hoe-werkt-de-scan.html): methodology and status interpretation.
- [EU AI Act information](https://aiwebscan.nl/eu-ai-act.html): general information, not legal advice.

## Legal and trust
- [Privacy](https://aiwebscan.nl/privacy.html)
- [Disclaimer](https://aiwebscan.nl/disclaimer.html)
- [Terms](https://aiwebscan.nl/voorwaarden.html)
- [Security disclosure](https://aiwebscan.nl/.well-known/security.txt)

## Optional
- [Agent discovery](https://agenticdiscovery.nl/): related discovery services.
- [UCP Scanner](https://ucpscanner.nl/): specialist commerce protocol tooling.
